criteria.WF-001: Idea → RFC: Turn an unshaped idea into a decision a team can act on, including the decision not to build it.
criteria.WF-002: RFC → Implementation: Build what was decided, with evidence, without widening the change.
criteria.WF-003: Bug → Root Cause: Find what is actually wrong before changing anything, and leave a test that would have caught it.
criteria.WF-004: Research: Establish what is known, what is contested and what is unknown, with provenance intact.
criteria.WF-005: Data source onboarding: Bring an external source in with its rights, its schema and its provenance established before any of it is trusted.
criteria.WF-009: Agent build: Add or change a runtime agent — one of the Jido agents behind the agent port — with its permissions, memory and failure behaviour decided rather than inherited.
criteria.WF-010: Agent evolution: Change what an agent is, with enough independent evidence that the change is an improvement rather than a fit to its own benchmark.
criteria.WF-014: API productization: Turn an internal capability into a contract other people depend on, which is a much larger commitment than exposing a function.
criteria.WF-015: Release: Move finished work to main with the full evidence, and a rollback path that exists before it is needed.
criteria.WF-016: Incident: Contain first, preserve the evidence, then find out why — and change something so it cannot recur.
criteria.WF-018: Organization evolution: Change how the project itself is organised — direction, priorities, capability — as a decision with evidence rather than a mood.
criteria.WF-019: Documentation drift: Find the prose a change just made false, before someone acts on it.
criteria.WF-020: Development evolution: When the same work keeps failing the same way, change the development system rather than retrying the work.

instructions: Which workflow fits the work item in `title` (and `body`, when given)? Choose by what KIND of work it is — a defect, a feature, a release, a documentation drift — not by which subsystem it mentions.
note: Asked of a model only as a second opinion; the deterministic router stays the decision. The options are this repository's workflow ids; an earlier change measures the router against a labelled corpus with this question's id and version.
